items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.title: Show HN: Sandbox platform on Kubernetes for secure remote access without secrets
items.contentSnippet:
Cordium is a FOSS, self-hosted, identity-based, general-purpose sandbox platform built on Kubernetes. The primary differentiator here is that Cordium automatically assigns an identity to each sandbox to provide "secretless" secure zero-trust remote access to resources/infrastructure (e.g. APIs, SSH, databases, k8s, etc.) without having to hold credentials and secrets (e.g. API keys and access tokens, SSH private keys/passwords, database passwords, mTLS private keys, etc.) inside the sandbox.

items.title: Show HN: Shirudo.today: Virtual eBPF patching on stock Linux
items.contentSnippet:
OpenAI's Shirudo needs kernel patches that still will take a couple more months, so we decided to make it available today. The threat model degrades to a compromised root, but makes the shirudo framework and shields available to stock linux kernels today. This enables patching a kernel vulnerability in hours instead of days.
